I was lying on the bed and suddenly i saw two men dressed in all white coming towards me, they greeted me and started talking to me and inquired about my health. i told them about my fever and body pain.They sat close to my legs started massaging my legs, i was feeling very comfortable and they pain just vanished. all the time they were talking to me but i dont remember what exactly they were talking but they made me feel very comfortable.i forgot every thing about the pain and was talking and laughing with them. Then all of a sudden I heard a sound calling my name,it was my uncle who was waking me up.When i opened my eyes The 2 person were not there. I asked my uncle about the 2 person & he told me that i must have seen a dream but i could not believe it because it was so real. But i could not recollect the faces of the 2 persons. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 38161 Country: India Title: Few days before I dreamt that I am in a big orchard. I cross a small river Question: Few days before I dreamt that I am in a big orchard. I cross a small river. There I meet a Hindu friend of mine. He offers me a cooked chicken but he says that it is not halal. I do not want to take it. Later he insists me. Then I take and I vomit very same movement. I feel so ashamed of myself and beg sorry to Allah in my dream. Please tell me the meaning of this dream. Answer ID: 38161 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 801/801/M=1433) You want to avoid sins but you get into it due to nafs and satan. You are careless in avoiding the sins. You should follow sunnah firmly and keep on doing taubah and istighfar. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
